name: Prof. Balaji Narasimhan
role: Professor, Department of Civil Engineering | Indian Institute of Technology Madras
bio: Hydrologist with 22+ years of experience modelling the impact of land use and climate change on hydrology using GIS, remote sensing, and hydrologic / hydraulic / crop-growth models at large river-basin scales. Lead investigator on India's flood forecasting systems and the Ganga River Basin Management Plan.
